evidence.evidence: AbstractWe explore a range of features and ensembles for the task of Native Language Identification as part of the NLI Shared Task .
Overall, across all three tasks, our best accuracy of 83.5% for the standard TOEFL11 test set came in second place.
Employing an ensemble classifier incorporating all of our features we achieved an accuracy of 82.2% (rank 5) in the closed task and 83.5% (rank 1) in the open-2 task.
AbstractWe explore a range of features and ensembles for the task of Native Language Identification as part of the NLI Shared Task .
